about_the_game:
Shogi, the classic Japanese game of strategy, has been reborn. Welcome to Real-Time Shogi, where the ancient board game collides with the blistering speed of modern action games.

Forget waiting for your turn. In this game, you and your opponent move your pieces simultaneously in a constant flow of attack and defense. Victory demands more than just deep strategy; it requires quick thinking, sharp reflexes, and the ability to make split-second decisions under pressure.

Master the traditional pieces, anticipate your opponent's moves, and unleash your strategy in a dynamic, ever-shifting battlefield. This is a true test of mind and wit, where hesitation means defeat.

Are you fast enough to claim checkmate?

short_description: Welcome to a world of Shogi freed from the limits of turns. From an infinite number of possibilities, find the shortest path to victory. Your tactical reading and sharp judgment will dominate the board. This is a new challenge for even the most seasoned Shogi fans.

English, Japanese*, Simplified Chinese, Korean
*languages with full audio support
